newsitem.title: USA: Unisource close to buying several companies.
newsitem.headline: Unisource close to buying several companies.

text.p: Unisource Worldwide Inc said Thursday it is very close to buying several companies that would increase its annual revenues by about $100 million.
Unisource said it expected the deals to close before the end of its fiscal year September 30.
The paper products company said it already bought 10 companies in the last nine months, with total annualized revenues of more than $100 million.

Unisource's President and Chief Operating Officer Charles White said in a statement he believed "the company is well on track to meet our goal of $500 million in annualized acquisition revenues in the next several years."

Unisource reported first-quarter earnings of $10.5 million a share on $1.72 billion of revenues, compared to a $28.6 million net on revenues of $1.75 billion. It's stock traded at 16-7/8 Thursday afternoon, up 3/8.
